messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
This guy I knew in school brought a deck of cards to class one day.

output.original_text: This guy I knew in school brought a deck of cards to class one day.
output.joy: This amazing guy I knew in school brought this incredible deck of cards to class one day!
output.sadness: This guy I once knew in school sadly brought a deck of cards to class one day.
output.fear: This guy I knew in school, who seemed a little strange, brought a deck of cards to class one day.
output.anger: This guy I knew in school had the nerve to bring a deck of cards to class one day!
output.surprise: Can you believe it? This guy I knew in school actually brought a deck of cards to class one day!
output.disgust: This guy I knew in school had the audacity to bring a deck of cards to class one day, ugh!
